packageRules.description: motion minors change how animations behave and CI cannot see it (the page transition wraps every page): proposed, never merged automatically
@types/node follows the Node that runs the app (22 in production, 24 in CI): no types of a newer major, they would let APIs through that production does not have

Sentry 11 sends request bodies, cookies and headers by default unless dataCollection is set, drops import-in-the-middle and changes the build instrumentation: a migration of its own, to validate on staging with the real DSN
c15t decides whether Google Analytics may load (consent banner, offline mode) and CI only sees part of it: an update is proposed and checked in a browser, never merged automatically
TanStack Table 9 changes the table API (hook, row models, state): the three admin lists need a migration of their own
